connections.why: Proteins build the organelles and cytoskeleton of cells

Blood transport delivers what homeostasis regulates
The immune response defends against invading pathogens
Mutation supplies the variation natural selection acts on
Inheritance of alleles drives changes in populations
Sequencing technologies revealed the human genome

Human activity disturbs population and ecosystem balance
